insight: Began as an AI copywriting tool, then repositioned as a 'GTM AI' platform unifying sales, marketing, and operations workflows.
name: Copy.ai
tagline: Go-to-market AI platform for sales and marketing workflows.
description: Copy.ai started as an AI copywriting assistant and now positions itself as a go-to-market (GTM) AI platform, consolidating sales, marketing, and operations work into reusable workflows. It combines a chat interface, a workflow builder, brand-voice controls, and a company knowledge base so teams can automate prospecting, content, and pipeline tasks.
edge: Targets whole go-to-market workflows — sales and marketing automation via reusable workflow credits — rather than only generating marketing copy.
